points.description: States the core idea: repeatedly find the minimum (smallest) element among the remaining/unsorted elements and swap/place it into the current position, moving left to right.
points.partial_credit: Award 2–3 marks if only part is given, e.g. says it finds the smallest element or sorts by selecting elements one at a time, but omits the swap/placing at the current position (or vice versa).

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating, in any wording, that selection sort repeatedly finds the minimum of the remaining elements and swaps/places it at the current position. Part marks for an answer with only half of this (e.g. just 'finds the smallest element' or 'swaps elements into place') or a vague but on-track description. No marks for descriptions of other sorts (e.g. adjacent swaps, inserting into a sorted part) or unrelated statements.
